meta.tldr:
Aider 0.86.0 significantly expands its AI model compatibility, now supporting all GPT-5 models, Grok-4 via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4`, and `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17`. Additionally, users can now leverage the `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2` model for diverse AI interactions. These updates provide developers with a wider array of powerful language models to choose from, enhancing flexibility and access to cutting-edge AI capabilities directly within their development workflows.

Command-line usability has been improved with `/clear` now providing a confirmation message "All chat history cleared." after execution, ensuring users know the command was successful. The `/undo` command's output has been refined to display only the first line of each commit message, making it much easier to review recent changes. The `/model` command, when invoked without arguments, now displays model announcements, keeping users informed about new or updated models.

Several important fixes are included in this release. An issue where new settings for an existing model failed to overwrite old ones has been resolved, ensuring model configurations are correctly applied. Analytics have been updated to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API, improving data collection reliability. Furthermore, dependencies have been bumped to `litellm==1.75.0`, bringing in the latest upstream improvements and bug fixes. This release primarily focuses on expanding model support and refining user experience, with no breaking changes reported. Users are encouraged to upgrade to take advantage of the new models and usability enhancements.
